events.title: Brave browser launched
events.summary: Brendan Eich's Brave Software released Brave v0.7 on January 20, 2016 — a Chromium-based browser focused on blocking ads and trackers by default.
events.about: Brave shipped with built-in ad and tracker blocking, [HTTPS] upgrades, and later a BAT micropayments model for publishers. Built on Chromium by the creator of JavaScript, it represented a privacy-first alternative in a market dominated by ad-driven browsers.

narrative.whyChosen: Brave popularized default privacy blocking in a mainstream Chromium fork.
narrative.whyImportant: It pushed the industry toward stricter tracking protection and alternative funding models.
narrative.problemSolved: Users wanted faster, safer browsing without installing extensions or fighting surveillance ads.
